response.justification: Bogdan is a strong senior/staff-level individual contributor with 15+ years of experience and genuine developer-tools exposure (test runners, CI/CD setup, DevOps infrastructure), but his resume shows no evidence of people management, direct reports, or formal team leadership at any point in his career. Since this role is explicitly a people-management position requiring 2+ years of managing/leading teams and running performance-focused one-on-ones, this is a fundamental mismatch despite solid technical alignment with the productivity/tooling focus area.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools and testing infrastructure (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, Selenium training, CI/CD setup)
18+ years of broad, adaptable software engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Some mobile-platform experience (iOS/Apple TV apps) aligning with the preferred mobile knowledge
concerns: No evidence of people management or formal team leadership anywhere in the resume — a hard requirement for this role
Career trajectory is entirely IC-focused (Senior/Staff titles) with no indication of roadmap ownership, org-level influence, or driving change across teams
No mention of conducting reviews, mentoring direct reports, or organizational change leadership expected at this management level

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools / testing infrastructure background
No formal technical leadership or roadmap-ownership evidence
